integrity: The upper bound is proved directly from one maximizing coordinate and the second-largest coordinate modulus; a two-coordinate finitely supported witness gives equality. The argument covers the full infinite-dimensional space and all defining parameters. Finite computations are supplementary only. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to the real sup norm on c_0(I). It does not classify pointwise James profiles on arbitrary C(K) spaces, and it makes no claim for a formal t=+infinity endpoint outside the defining parameter range.
title: Exact pointwise James type profile on real \(c_0(I)\)
